description.value: The Dolar Shop Burnaby, branded on the website as The Dolar Shop Station Square, is a Macau-style hot pot restaurant where guests cook fresh, house-made ingredients in individual tabletop pots at their own pace. The concept draws on East-West culinary influences rooted in Macau, emphasizing premium ingredients, communal dining, and a philosophy of continuous innovation. The restaurant features both indoor and outdoor seating and is wheelchair accessible.
